notes.note: Reviewed the new explicit GET /api/analytics/station-usage leaf declaration against its mounted route and runtime callback. It is read-only, local-instance-only, and additionally requires bound home-possession operator proof on a personal nonhosted host. Ordinary pairing read scope alone cannot enter it; the existing management floor for peer-aware usage-rollup stays unchanged. This isolated addition changes no existing scope defaults, mutation, fleet contribution, proxy, audience, theming or request-cancellation contract cited by this document. The 151 route-scope tests pass after declaration. No actual provider/billing or hosted operator qualification claimed.
